description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Knuckle Oil Seal Plate Bolts for the Inner Seals.
These are located on the backside of the Steering Knuckle.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 5 – Bolts, Knuckle Oil Seal Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
